fields.name: Query parameter names
fields.definition: The optional list of parameter names declared on a Query. When present, only parameters whose names are in the list are applied to the command, so one model can feed queries that each expect a different subset of its mapped parameters (an INSERT without `LastModified`, an UPDATE with it). When absent, every parameter in the collection is sent. Extra or missing parameters are errors raised by the database, not by ArgentSea.
